description: Header file defining the QhullPoint class, which represents a point with coordinates and dimension in the Qhull computational geometry library. It includes constructors, accessors, operators, and IO functions related to Qhull points.

classes.name: QhullPoint
classes.description: Represents a point in the Qhull library with coordinates, dimension, and associated methods for access, comparison, and IO.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the point's coordinates to a standard vector of coordT.

methods.name: toQList
methods.description: Converts the point's coordinates to a QList of coordT (Qt-specific).

methods.name: coordinates
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the point's coordinates.

methods.name: defineAs
methods.description: Sets the point's coordinates and optionally its dimension.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two QhullPoint instances.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the distance between this point and another QhullPoint.
